<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Dancing golden chick</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:244px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#fffdfd}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xfffdfd);
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244,240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122/60,122/60,2,-2,.1,50);
ref.position.set(0,2.32,10);
ref.lookAt(0,2,0);

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const chick=group(scene,'golden-chick',.045,0,0);
const figure=group(chick,'body and face');
const trunk=group(figure,'body');
const head=group(figure,'head',0,3.16,0);
const color=s=>new THREE.Color(s);
function smooth(a,b,x){
  const u=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);
  return u*u*(3-2*u);
}
const down=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:1});
function surface(parent,name,sample,rows=80,cols=112){
  const p=[],c=[],ix=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++){
    for(let i=0;i<=cols;i++){
      const [x,y,z,tint]=sample(j/rows,2*Math.PI*i/cols);
      p.push(x,y,z);
      c.push(tint.r,tint.g,tint.b);
      if(i<cols && j<rows){
        const k=j*(cols+1)+i;
        ix.push(k,k+1,k+cols+1,k+1,k+cols+2,k+cols+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(c,3));
  geo.setIndex(ix);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,down);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
const rings=[
 [-.58,.012,.012],[-.49,.74,.59],[-.25,1.19,.91],[.02,1.36,1.04],
 [.34,1.47,1.11],[.70,1.49,1.14],[1.10,1.44,1.10],
 [1.56,1.35,1.02],[2,1.25,.94],[2.40,1.12,.84],[2.72,.98,.76],
 [2.99,.80,.68],[3.16,.70,.63],[3.40,.62,.57],
 [3.70,.575,.54],[3.88,.51,.49],[4.02,.38,.37],[4.11,.19,.19],[4.14,.004,.004]
];
function radius(y,k){
  let i=0;
  while(i<rings.length-2 && y>rings[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=rings[i],b=rings[i+1],prev=rings[Math.max(0,i-1)],next=rings[Math.min(rings.length-1,i+2)];
  const h=b[0]-a[0],t=(y-a[0])/h;
  return (1-t)*(1-t)*(1+2*t)*a[k]+t*t*(3-2*t)*b[k]+
    t*(1-t)*(1-t)*h*(b[k]-prev[k])/(b[0]-prev[0])-
    t*t*(1-t)*h*(next[k]-a[k])/(next[0]-a[0]);
}
const gold=color('#ffbd21'),cream=color('#ffddaa'),crown=color('#ffe346'),lo=color('#e89b30');
function coat(parent,name,y0,y1,offset){
  surface(parent,name,(u,a)=>{
    const y=y0+(y1-y0)*u,s=Math.sin(a),f=Math.cos(a);
    const x=radius(y,1)*s,z=radius(y,2)*f+.035*smooth(2.8,3.8,y);
    const tint=gold.clone().lerp(lo,(1-smooth(.05,1,y))*.68);
    const bib=(1-smooth(.60,1.35,Math.abs(x)))*smooth(.02,.70,f)*
      (1-smooth(2.20,2.57,y+.23*x*x))*smooth(-.42,.7,y);
    tint.lerp(cream,bib*.96).lerp(crown,smooth(3.45,3.87,y)*.96);
    return [x,y-offset,z,tint];
  });
}
coat(trunk,'pear-shaped torso',-.58,3.16,0);
coat(head,'rounded crown',3.16,4.14,3.16);

function oval(parent,name,xyz,scale,tint,roughness=.9){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:tint,roughness}));
  m.name=name;
  m.position.set(...xyz);
  m.scale.set(...scale);
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(head,side<0?'left eye':'right eye',side*.345,.49+(side>0?.055:0),.448);
  eye.rotation.y=side*.50;
  oval(eye,'golden eye surround',[0,0,0],[.115,.142,.066],0xe6b52a);
  oval(eye,'dark eye',[0,.008,.047],[.078,.098,.045],0x19170f,.65);
}
const mouth=group(head,'beak',-.013,.318,.574);
const bill=oval(mouth,'upper bill',[0,.012,.035],[.206,.077,.172],0xffbb36);
bill.rotation.x=.12;
oval(mouth,'lower bill',[0,-.043,.060],[.165,.049,.123],0xea9b2d);

// Each wing curls out from the shoulder, around the elbow and up to the tip.
// Landmarks give the visible elbow and the terminal point in the reference view.
const frames=[
 {t:0,    drop:0,   roll: .052,left:[60,138,62,73], right:[211,124,216,62]},
 {t:160,  drop:1,   roll:-.058,left:[29,115,16,55], right:[185,139,153,78]},
 {t:340,  drop:5,   roll: .045,left:[57,148,49,88], right:[211,136,210,75]},
 {t:500,  drop:11,  roll: .005,left:[31,147,18,93], right:[194,158,188,101]},
 {t:680,  drop:7,   roll: .014,left:[31,139,18,88], right:[192,149,174,89]},
 {t:840,  drop:1,   roll: .043,left:[58,138,56,78], right:[211,136,211,75]},
 {t:1020, drop:5,   roll:-.040,left:[29,130,17,74], right:[187,152,168,94]},
 {t:1180, drop:10,  roll: .022,left:[50,155,40,99], right:[210,155,213,93]}
];
const wingGold=color('#ffb521'),tip=color('#64401e'),tipTop=color('#44301e');
function makeWing(side){
  const label=side<0?'left':'right';
  const wing=group(chick,label+' wing');
  const hand=group(wing,label+' wingtip');
  function point(px,py,z){
    return new THREE.Vector3((px-122)/60-.045,2+((120-py)/60+.031984*z)/.999488,z);
  }
  const poses=frames.map(frame=>{
    const [ex,ey,tx,ty]=frame[label];
    const bend=side<0?1:-1;
    const thickness=1+side*(ex-122)/175;
    const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      point(ex+bend*19,ey-22,.19),
      point(ex+bend*8,ey-3,.41),
      point(ex,ey,.65),
      point(ex*.73+tx*.27,ey*.72+ty*.28,.88),
      point(ex*.35+tx*.65,ey*.37+ty*.63,1.06),
      point(tx+bend*3,ty+13,1.17),
      point(tx,ty,1.20)
    ]);
    return {path,width:THREE.MathUtils.clamp(1.36-.27*thickness,.90,1.05)};
  });
  const meshes=[];
  function section(parent,name,start,end){
    function build(pose){
      return surface(parent,name,(u,a)=>{
        const t=start+(end-start)*u;
        const p=pose.path.getPoint(t),tangent=pose.path.getTangent(t);
        const across=new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0);
        across.addScaledVector(tangent,-tangent.x).normalize();
        const front=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(across,tangent).normalize();
        const r=Math.pow(Math.max(.000001,Math.sin(Math.PI*t)),.59)*(.433-.084*t)*pose.width;
        p.addScaledVector(across,r*Math.sin(a)).addScaledVector(front,r*.90*Math.cos(a));
        const tint=wingGold.clone().lerp(tip,smooth(.635,.76,t+.042*Math.cos(a)))
          .lerp(tipTop,.75*smooth(.78,.98,t));
        return [p.x,p.y,p.z,tint];
      },32,48);
    }
    const base=build(poses[0]);
    const geo=base.geometry;
    geo.morphAttributes.position=[];
    geo.morphAttributes.normal=[];
    for(let i=1;i<poses.length;i++){
      const target=build(poses[i]);
      geo.morphAttributes.position.push(target.geometry.attributes.position);
      geo.morphAttributes.normal.push(target.geometry.attributes.normal);
      parent.remove(target);
      target.geometry.dispose();
    }
    base.updateMorphTargets();
    meshes.push(base);
  }
  section(wing,'curved golden flipper',0,.68);
  section(hand,'dark flipper end',.68,1);
  return meshes;
}
const wings=[...makeWing(-1),...makeWing(1)];
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const foot=group(chick,side<0?'left foot':'right foot',side*.62,-.47,.25);
  oval(foot,'webbed foot',[0,0,.13],[.37,.13,.52],0xe7a037);
}

const floor=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200,200),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xfffdfd}));
floor.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
floor.position.y=-.605;
scene.add(floor);
const shadeCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');
shadeCanvas.width=shadeCanvas.height=64;
const ctx=shadeCanvas.getContext('2d');
const grad=ctx.createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);
grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,111,118,.32)');
grad.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(146,140,147,.18)');
grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(170,166,176,0)');
ctx.fillStyle=grad;
ctx.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
const shadow=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(6,9),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:new THREE.CanvasTexture(shadeCanvas),transparent:true,depthWrite:false}));
shadow.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
shadow.position.y=-.60;
scene.add(shadow);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaf0,0xffdfad,1.55));
function lamp(x,y,z,power,hue){
  const light=new THREE.DirectionalLight(hue,power);
  light.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(light);
}
lamp(-3,6,4,1.52,0xfff8de);
lamp(4,2,2,.52,0xfff3d7);
lamp(1,4,-5,1.12,0xffffff);

function render(t){
  const time=((t%1200)+1200)%1200;
  let i=0;
  while(i+1<frames.length && frames[i+1].t<=time) i++;
  const j=(i+1)%frames.length,a=frames[i],b=frames[j];
  const weight=smooth(a.t,j===0?1200:b.t,time);
  for(const mesh of wings){
    const w=mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
    w.fill(0);
    if(i>0) w[i-1]=1-weight;
    if(j>0) w[j-1]=weight;
  }
  const drop=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a.drop,b.drop,weight);
  figure.scale.y=1-drop/270;
  figure.position.y=(figure.scale.y-1)*.48;
  const roll=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a.roll,b.roll,weight);
  // Roll about the face while keeping the base of the neck continuous.
  figure.rotation.z=(roll-.052)*.15;
  head.rotation.z=(roll-.052)*.85;
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[chick],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
